# Assessment Submission Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that the submission package, final report, and claims are defined and supported by evidence
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Legend**: `[M]` mandatory (a constitution MUST, an approved requirement, or an approved decision); `[O]` optional enhancement or backlog boundary. `G0` is evaluable now against the approved specification, plan, ADRs, and contracts; `G1` is evaluable after `/speckit-tasks` and `/speckit-analyze`, before implementation. `{Detects: ...}` links an item to a failure pattern in the [README](README.md) detection matrix. Dimension tags: Completeness, Clarity, Consistency, Measurability, Coverage, Traceability, Edge Case, Assumption, Conflict, Gap.
## Package and Inputs

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the official assessment requirements identified as an input artifact with a location, or their absence recorded as a known limitation? [Gap, Spec DEC-005] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the submission package defined (repository state, final report, evidence, ADRs, spec, plan) with mandatory and optional components distinguished? [Completeness, Spec DEC-111, Orchestration G-FINAL] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the reviewer criteria (behavior, architecture, decisions, AI-assisted process, decomposition, testing, governance, traceability, change history, documentation, judgment) each mapped to an evidence location? [Traceability, Constitution preamble, Plan] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the reviewer's read-only access defined (READER credential, GitHub read access)? [Coverage, Spec DEC-018, DEC-112] [M, G0]

## Final Report and Claims

- [ ] CHK005 - Is the final report content defined, with every claim required to link to recorded evidence? [Measurability, Spec FR-129, DEC-111] [M, G0] {Detects: unsupported-completion-claims}
- [ ] CHK006 - Must the final report state the provenance boundary, evidence modes, limitations, cuts and their effects, and tested versus declared versions? [Completeness, ADR-013, Plan §6, Spec DEC-071] [M, G0] {Detects: unsupported-completion-claims}
- [ ] CHK007 - Is it defined that results in the report come from executed runs, with synthetic and simulated data labelled? [Coverage, Spec FR-131 NAC, Constitution X] [M, G0] {Detects: fabricated-results}
- [ ] CHK008 - Must open items at submission (deferred, backlog, untested) be listed explicitly? [Coverage, Plan §6.1] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is a fresh verification output tied to the submitted commit required? [Measurability, Spec DEC-099] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the submitted commit or state identified (hash or tag)? [Gap, Constitution X] [M, G0]

## Final Decision

- [ ] CHK011 - Is G-FINAL defined as the human's submission decision, with the timeout and no-inference rules? [Coverage, Orchestration §6, Spec FR-114] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the final state defined (no open mandatory gate, no uncommitted work, all human decisions recorded)? [Measurability, Spec FR-114, Constitution III] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is it defined that only the human may declare the submission complete? [Coverage, Constitution III] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is a demonstration walkthrough labelled optional? [Coverage, Plan] [O, G0]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items marked `[Gap]` or `[Conflict]` name a place where the current documents are silent or disagree; they are findings for the reviewer to resolve, not pre-judged results
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially within this file (`CHK001` onward); cite them as `<file>:CHKnnn`
